name: Hoshi Furu Umi ni ~Koi no Sanjuusou~
original_name: 星降る海に ～恋の三重奏～
source:
At summer vacation Makoto Ozawa invited his five classmates and friends - six people - to go on a trip to the beach together. 
During those three days that they spend in this trip they will develop a spiritual bond at this magical seaside.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-july-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
暑假期间，小泽诚邀请他的五位同学和朋友——共六人——一起去海边旅行。在那三天的旅程中，他们将在这片神奇的海边发展出精神上的羁绊。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-july-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
